metadata.author: Mike Shaw
metadata.description: Photo of Pyrus korshinskyi (Kazakh Pear) in blossom at the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, Scotland. The plant label on the tree states that it is "UK & Ireland Champion Tree Girth & Height". The tree is critically endangered. An informational sign next to the tree states that the tree is dedicated to the memory of Ann Deans.
